messages:
maya: PR #842 is up to update the CLI evidence export examples for SOC2 workflows. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
jon: nice — what's the flag for anonymizing PII? :eyes:
maya: it's --anonymize, added an example and a short note about PII handling and when to request identifiers.
seema: please make sure we explicitly call out consent vs legal_request/legal_hold flows. suggested copy: "Exports include events within requested TTL and are redacted by default; use --include-identifiers only with legal approval."
jon: can we include a runnable CLI sample in the snippet? keeps it easier for customers.
maya: added a minimal example in the PR: 
```bash
redwood export-evidence --since 2023-01-01 --until 2023-03-01 --format jsonl --anonymize
```
maya: also included a second example for legal/forensic exports (must be gated by legal ops):
```bash
redwood export-evidence --since 2023-01-01 --format jsonl --include-identifiers --auth-token $TOKEN
```
seema: tiny wording ask: prefer "user-identifiers" over "identifiers" and add a pointer to the legal playbook: https://redwood-internal/legal/export-process
jon: ack. also add a short note that anonymized exports can break forensic correlation (stable ids removed) so customers should request full exports only when necessary.
maya: added both notes and pushed another commit. @seema @jon can you quick-review the phrasing?
seema: will review this afternoon. nit: change "will redact" -> "are redacted by default" to avoid passive/unclear wording.
jon: LGTM after that nit is fixed.
docsboss: heads-up — this touches docs/cli/export.md and the compliance guidance page. mark PR as blocked until compliance sign-off; make sure to request a review from the compliance team.
deploy-bot: link-checker: all links in the PR currently pass :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks — I'll request compliance and wait for their OK before merge.
seema: left a short checklist comment in the PR about retention TTL phrasing and audit trail mention.
jon: ran the snippets locally; they work as-is.
maya: plan: merge after compliance sign-off and then backfill a short changelog entry. :shipit:
